name: dbydd-pi-anchored-tool-for-dspro
description: Pi extension: anchor a target model's first request to a minimal tool catalog (shell + read), restore the full catalog after the first tool call. For DeepSeek V4 Pro — 91/92 Standard vs 99/96 Minimal on Project2. Port of xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard.
